stem: A contamination event could plausibly come from donor material, one medium lot, or a transfer-day workflow error. What corrective-action strategy preserves the most diagnostic value?
choices: Use the records to rank hypotheses and change the smallest number of variables needed to test them
Change donor, medium, disinfectant and workflow all at once
Declare the first suspected cause confirmed
Ignore clustering and treat every vessel independently
rationale: Corrective action should reduce uncertainty without destroying the ability to identify which factor mattered.
